dataset_info.name: MORPHE Evaluation Benchmark
dataset_info.description: Ground-truth technical knowledge records across programming, vector databases, and machine learning designed to test adaptive graph memory reconfiguration.

modules.name: Mixed Core Topics (Overloaded)
modules.description: Artificially mixed cluster containing distinct sub-topics (Java OOP and Linear Algebra Math) designed for Split operation

records.text: Java supports object-oriented principles including encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.
Java classes can implement multiple interfaces but inherit from only one abstract class.
Java method overriding allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a parent method.
Java garbage collection automatically reclaims heap memory by destroying unreachable objects.
Java abstract classes cannot be instantiated directly and often contain abstract method declarations.
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors represent directional scaling transformations in linear algebra.
Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) factors a matrix into constituent orthogonal matrices and singular values.
Dot product measures the projection of one vector onto another and yields cosine similarity when normalized.
Matrix multiplication is associative but generally non-commutative across dimensional transformations.
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) computes orthogonal eigenvectors to maximize variance in dimensionality reduction.

modules.name: Vector Indexing Engines
modules.description: Vector indexing engines and approximate nearest neighbor search (high overlap with B)

records.text: FAISS provides fast approximate nearest neighbor search using inverted file index and product quantization.
Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs offer logarithmic time complexity for vector similarity retrieval.
Cosine distance and Euclidean L2 distance are standard distance metrics for comparing dense vector embeddings.
Vector databases index high-dimensional embeddings generated by transformer models for semantic search.

modules.name: Embedding Retrieval Systems
modules.description: Dense embedding retrieval and vector similarity tools (redundant with Module A, target for Merge)

records.text: Vector retrieval systems utilize approximate nearest neighbors algorithms to compare query embeddings against documents.
HNSW index structures enable scalable semantic search across millions of dense embedding vectors.
Product Quantization compresses dense vector representations to reduce memory usage in large-scale vector search.
Dense vector retrieval compares high-dimensional semantic vectors using cosine similarity.

modules.name: Python Data Engineering
modules.description: Python data processing tools (NumPy, Pandas) frequently co-accessed with Machine Learning Workflows

records.text: NumPy provides ndarray objects for efficient vector and matrix computations in Python.
Pandas DataFrames support tabular data manipulation, filtering, aggregation, and time-series operations.
Polars is an ultra-fast columnar DataFrame library implemented in Rust with a Python API.
Vectorized operations in NumPy eliminate explicit Python loops for substantial performance acceleration.

modules.name: Machine Learning Pipelines
modules.description: Model training, inference, and evaluation (frequently co-accessed with Python Data Engineering)

records.text: PyTorch tensors support automatic differentiation via autograd for gradient-based neural network optimization.
Cross-entropy loss measures the discrepancy between predicted probability distributions and true categorical labels.
Adam optimizer dynamically adapts learning rates using first and second momentum estimates of gradients.
DataLoaders in PyTorch handle batching, shuffling, and multi-threaded data prefetching for model training.
